summary: Short kerb on busy Stamford Road beside an electrical substation, no parked cars.

drivers.seclusion: Substation and retail buildings only; no homes, but fully exposed to the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts the through lane; narrow verge and fence, no pull-off.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Open; trees on the east verge shade the late afternoon.
